content.title: Sector Policing
content.summary: Arvada's sector policing program focuses on enhancing community safety through citizen involvement, with police officers assigned to four sectors: Adam, Baker, Charlie, and Delta. Each sector has a dedicated team led by a Commander and includes various officers, while overall police operations are managed by the Chief of Police and other senior officials. For emergencies, residents should call 911, and for non-emergency matters, the contact number is 303-980-7300.
content.body:
For all **emergencies**, dial **911**. For **non-emergency police**matters, please dial 303-980-7300.

In Arvada, we believe that community safety is directly tied to citizen involvement. Sector policing enables Arvada's police officers to become experts on the needs, issues, and concerns of the people within the specific areas, or sectors, to which they are assigned.

Arvada has four current sectors-Adam, Baker, Charlie, and Delta - that have teams composed of one Commander, Sergeants, Detectives, and numerous officers including School Resource Officers. While much of the day-to-day policing decisions and resource allocations are made at the sector level by sector command staff, police operations throughout the City are overseen by the Chief of Police, Deputy Chief of Operations, and Deputy Chief of Patrol.
